title.fa: بهای اخلاقی جامعه‌شناسیِ آزاد از ارزش: نقد دارندرف بر وبر
title.en: The moral cost of value-free sociology: Dahrendorf on Weber
title.nl: The moral cost of value-free sociology: Dahrendorf on Weber

summary.fa: دارندرف می‌گوید منطق تفکیک وبر میان علم و حکم ارزشی درست است، ولی تأکید او خطا بود: علوم اجتماعی نیروی اخلاقی‌ای تولید می‌کنند که اگر آگاهانه مهار نشود علیه آزادی و فردیت کار می‌کند، و اخلاقی مستقل از علم نمی‌تواند جلوی آن را بگیرد. نتیجه، جامعه‌شناسی در یک تعارض نقشی حل‌نشدنی است.
summary.en: Dahrendorf holds that the logic of Weber’s separation of science from value judgement is sound but his emphasis was wrong: the social sciences generate a moral force which, unbridled, works against freedom and individuality, and an ethics independent of science cannot stop it. The result is that sociology stands in an insoluble role conflict.
summary.nl: Dahrendorf holds that the logic of Weber’s separation of science from value judgement is sound but his emphasis was wrong: the social sciences generate a moral force which, unbridled, works against freedom and individuality, and an ethics independent of science cannot stop it. The result is that sociology stands in an insoluble role conflict.

text.fa: تاریخ‌دانان نخستین کسانی بودند که تعارض انسان کامل و سایهٔ جامعه‌شناسانه‌اش را دریافتند. وقتی تاریخ‌دان بخواهد یک وضعیت منحصربه‌فرد را در تمامیتش دریابد، نظریه‌های علمی تنهایش می‌گذارند؛ او نمی‌تواند آقای اشمیت را از روی نقش‌هایش بازسازی کند.
text.en: Historians were the first to feel the conflict between whole man and his sociological shadow. When a historian tries to grasp one unique situation in its totality, scientific theories abandon him; he cannot reconstruct Mr Schmidt out of his roles.
text.nl: Historians were the first to feel the conflict between whole man and his sociological shadow. When a historian tries to grasp one unique situation in its totality, scientific theories abandon him; he cannot reconstruct Mr Schmidt out of his roles.

text.fa: دارندرف از موسیل وام می‌گیرد: «انسان فراسرزمینی» و «انسان سرزمینی» دو حوزهٔ جدا و بی‌مزاحمت نیستند. انسان فراسرزمینی عصیانی علیه انسان سرزمینی است چون حق حاکمیت او را انکار می‌کند، و انسان سرزمینی می‌کوشد با قوانین خود به فضاهای خالی آن دیگری راه یابد.
text.en: Dahrendorf borrows from Musil: the "extraterritorial" and the "territorial" man are not two separate zones coexisting undisturbed. The extraterritorial man is a revolt against the territorial one because he denies his sovereignty, while the territorial man tries to push his own laws into the other’s empty spaces.
text.nl: Dahrendorf borrows from Musil: the "extraterritorial" and the "territorial" man are not two separate zones coexisting undisturbed. The extraterritorial man is a revolt against the territorial one because he denies his sovereignty, while the territorial man tries to push his own laws into the other’s empty spaces.

text.fa: پس انسان اجتماعی اسباب‌بازی خصوصی روشنفکران در برج عاج نیست بلکه تهدیدی جدی برای انسان اخلاقی است — پارادوکسی که نقد متعالی کانت حلش نمی‌کند، چون در جامعه‌ای رخ می‌دهد که آمادهٔ تبدیل نظریهٔ علمی به عقل متعارف است.
text.en: Homo sociologicus is therefore not intellectuals’ private toy in an ivory tower but a serious threat to moral man — a paradox Kant’s transcendental critique cannot resolve, because it arises in a society ready to turn scientific theory into common sense.
text.nl: Homo sociologicus is therefore not intellectuals’ private toy in an ivory tower but a serious threat to moral man — a paradox Kant’s transcendental critique cannot resolve, because it arises in a society ready to turn scientific theory into common sense.

text.fa: نمونه‌های عملی که دارندرف می‌آورد: دادگاه‌ها با توضیحات کارشناسی علوم اجتماعی روز‌به‌روز بیشتر در تعیین تقصیر متهم به مشکل می‌خورند، و غیرانسانی‌ترین رفتار برای گزارشگرِ آموزش‌دیدهٔ جامعه‌شناسی و خوانندگانش به نتیجهٔ «ضروری» علل خاص بدل می‌شود. دور نیست زمانی که انسان اجتماعیِ عاری از فردیت و مسئولیت، جای فردِ آزاد و مسئول را در تلقی مردم بگیرد.
text.en: The concrete cases Dahrendorf gives: courts find it ever harder to establish a defendant’s guilt against social-scientific expert testimony, and the most inhuman behaviour becomes, for the sociologically trained reporter and his readers, the "necessary" result of particular causes. The time is not far off when homo sociologicus, void of individuality and responsibility, replaces the free and responsible individual in people’s understanding.
text.nl: The concrete cases Dahrendorf gives: courts find it ever harder to establish a defendant’s guilt against social-scientific expert testimony, and the most inhuman behaviour becomes, for the sociologically trained reporter and his readers, the "necessary" result of particular causes. The time is not far off when homo sociologicus, void of individuality and responsibility, replaces the free and responsible individual in people’s understanding.

text.fa: تعارض نقشی خودِ جامعه‌شناسی: از یک سو پیشرفت علمی از آن انتظار می‌رود (که انسان را از خود بیگانه می‌کند) و از سوی دیگر کمک به رهایی انسان از جبرهای بیرونی، یعنی حفظ آقای اشمیت به‌عنوان فردی آزاد و آگاه و مسئول.
text.en: Sociology’s own role conflict: on one side scientific progress is expected of it (which estranges man), on the other help in freeing man from external compulsions — that is, keeping Mr Schmidt a free, conscious, responsible individual.
text.nl: Sociology’s own role conflict: on one side scientific progress is expected of it (which estranges man), on the other help in freeing man from external compulsions — that is, keeping Mr Schmidt a free, conscious, responsible individual.

text.fa: قیاس دارندرف: چنان‌که پزشک در تعارض انتظارات بیمار و انتظارات سازمان بیمه تصمیم می‌گیرد بیمار را کمتر مورد توجه قرار دهد تا گرفتار عقوبت دیوان‌سالاری نشود، جامعه‌شناسان هم وظایف اخلاقی خود را با دقت و بی‌تفاوتی روش علمی معاوضه کردند. انتخاب آسان بود — بیماران به پزشک و مردم به جامعه‌شناس ضرری نمی‌رسانند، ولی سازمان و جامعهٔ علمی می‌توانند عضوشان را برکنار یا اخراج کنند — ولی شایسته نبود، چون عواقبش زیانبارتر بود.
text.en: Dahrendorf’s analogy: just as the doctor, caught between the patient’s expectations and the insurer’s, decides to attend less to the patient so as to escape bureaucratic punishment, sociologists traded their moral duties for the precision and indifference of scientific method. The choice was easy — patients cannot harm doctors and people cannot harm sociologists, while organizations and the scientific community can dismiss or expel a member — but it was not right, because its consequences were far more damaging.
text.nl: Dahrendorf’s analogy: just as the doctor, caught between the patient’s expectations and the insurer’s, decides to attend less to the patient so as to escape bureaucratic punishment, sociologists traded their moral duties for the precision and indifference of scientific method. The choice was easy — patients cannot harm doctors and people cannot harm sociologists, while organizations and the scientific community can dismiss or expel a member — but it was not right, because its consequences were far more damaging.

text.fa: طنز تلخ: همان کسی که در جامعه‌شناسی به سود ادعای علمی‌بودن و علیه ادعای اخلاقی‌بودن رأی داد — ماکس وبر — شاید بیش از هر جامعه‌شناس دیگری به اولویت معضل انسان دوگانه آگاه بود.
text.en: The bitter irony: the very man who voted in sociology for the claim to be scientific and against the claim to be moral — Max Weber — was perhaps more aware than any other sociologist of the primacy of the two-man problem.
text.nl: The bitter irony: the very man who voted in sociology for the claim to be scientific and against the claim to be moral — Max Weber — was perhaps more aware than any other sociologist of the primacy of the two-man problem.

text.fa: دارندرف منطق تفکیک وبر را می‌پذیرد: هشدار او در برابر آمیختن ارزش‌های عملی و دیدگاه‌های علمی به‌حق است و تفکیکش کاربرد مشروع تمایز کانت میان منش تجربی و عقلی است. خطا در منطق نبود، در نحوهٔ تأکید بود.
text.en: Dahrendorf accepts the logic of Weber’s distinction: his warning against mixing practical values with scientific views is right, and his separation is a legitimate application of Kant’s distinction between empirical and rational character. The error lay not in the logic but in the emphasis.
text.nl: Dahrendorf accepts the logic of Weber’s distinction: his warning against mixing practical values with scientific views is right, and his separation is a legitimate application of Kant’s distinction between empirical and rational character. The error lay not in the logic but in the emphasis.

text.fa: آن خطای تأکید: وبر ندید که نتایج علوم اجتماعی خود نیرویی اخلاقی به دنبال دارند که اگر آگاهانه مهار نشود با چنان قدرتی علیه ارزش‌های آزادی و فردیت کار می‌کند که اخلاقی مستقل از علم به‌هیچ‌وجه نمی‌تواند متوقفش کند.
text.en: The error of emphasis: Weber did not see that the findings of social science themselves carry a moral force which, if not consciously bridled, works against the values of freedom and individuality so powerfully that an ethics independent of science cannot stop it.
text.nl: The error of emphasis: Weber did not see that the findings of social science themselves carry a moral force which, if not consciously bridled, works against the values of freedom and individuality so powerfully that an ethics independent of science cannot stop it.

text.fa: آن‌چه در شخصیت قدرتمند وبر یکی بود — انعطاف‌ناپذیری علمی آزاد از ارزش‌گذاری، و شور در موضع‌گیری اخلاقی — به‌زودی از هم جدا شد؛ آن‌چه ماند جامعه‌شناسیِ آزاد از ارزش بود و گم‌شدن انسانی که جلال و مرتبهٔ آزادی و فردیت داشت. تأکید وبر از شرایط تاریخی و بحث‌های «انجمن سیاست اجتماعی» قابل فهم است.
text.en: What Weber’s forceful personality still held together — the inflexibility of a value-free science and passionate moral commitment — soon came apart; what remained was value-free sociology and the loss of man as a being with the dignity of freedom and individuality. Weber’s emphasis is understandable from his historical situation and the debates of the Verein für Sozialpolitik.
text.nl: What Weber’s forceful personality still held together — the inflexibility of a value-free science and passionate moral commitment — soon came apart; what remained was value-free sociology and the loss of man as a being with the dignity of freedom and individuality. Weber’s emphasis is understandable from his historical situation and the debates of the Verein für Sozialpolitik.

text.fa: کم نیستند جامعه‌شناسانی که آگاهی به خصلت فرضیِ انسان ساختگی خود را از دست داده‌اند؛ وقتی آن‌ها انسان اجتماعی را با فرد خودمختار اشتباه می‌گیرند، جای تعجب نیست که خوانندگان و دانشجویان هم تبعیت کنند — و از آن‌جا تا جهان ۱۹۸۴ فاصله‌ای نمی‌ماند.
text.en: There is no shortage of sociologists who have lost awareness of the hypothetical character of their constructed man; when they confuse homo sociologicus with the autonomous individual, no wonder readers and students follow — and from there no distance remains to the world of 1984.
text.nl: There is no shortage of sociologists who have lost awareness of the hypothetical character of their constructed man; when they confuse homo sociologicus with the autonomous individual, no wonder readers and students follow — and from there no distance remains to the world of 1984.

text.fa: دارندرف همچنین هشدار می‌دهد که می‌توان از دیدگاه‌های جامعه‌شناسی برای نگه‌داشتن رژیم‌های توتالیتر در قدرت استفاده کرد، یا در «روابط صنعتی» برای ترفندهایی که کارگر را از اعتصاب و درخواست افزایش دستمزد بازمی‌دارند. (یادداشت پایانی کتاب)
text.en: Dahrendorf also warns that sociological insight can be used to keep totalitarian regimes in power, or in "industrial relations" for devices that stop workers striking or asking for higher pay. (Endnote in the book.)
text.nl: Dahrendorf also warns that sociological insight can be used to keep totalitarian regimes in power, or in "industrial relations" for devices that stop workers striking or asking for higher pay. (Endnote in the book.)

text.fa: پس نتیجهٔ او تسلیم نیست: بی‌معناست که «گالیلهٔ آیندهٔ جامعه‌شناسی» را به انکار علنی نظرگاه‌هایش وادار کنیم، چون سوگند دروغین گالیلهٔ واقعی هم جلوی پیشرفت فیزیک را نگرفت. سرکوب بدترین وسیله برای حل تعارض است؛ بهتر است به‌جای گذشتن از کنار معضل، آن را با نهایت دقت و وضوح بررسی کنیم.
text.en: His conclusion is therefore not surrender: it would be senseless to force "sociology’s future Galileo" into a public recantation, since the real Galileo’s false oath did not stop physics either. Suppression is the worst means of settling a conflict; better to examine the problem with the utmost precision and clarity than to walk past it.
text.nl: His conclusion is therefore not surrender: it would be senseless to force "sociology’s future Galileo" into a public recantation, since the real Galileo’s false oath did not stop physics either. Suppression is the worst means of settling a conflict; better to examine the problem with the utmost precision and clarity than to walk past it.
